latvia.title: Fregata „Regele Ferdinand” revine la Constanța după cinci săptămâni de misiune NATO în Mediterana
latvia.description: Fregata „Regele Ferdinand” revine în ţară, la începutul săptămânii viitoare, după ce a participat, timp de cinci săptămâni, la o misiune NATO în Marea Mediterană, au anunţat, joi, reprezentanţii Forţelor Navale Române. Ei au precizat că nava a executat activităţi de supraveghere şi de monitorizare a traficului maritim în zona respectivă.

latvia.title: Senatorul PNL Varga Glad explică de ce crește cota la ursul brun: „Viețile unor oameni și familii au fost schimbate pentru totdeauna”
latvia.description: Președintele Comisiei pentru mediu din Senatul Româmâniei, Senatorul PNL Varga Glad, a explicat pe pagina sa de Facebook de ce a crescut cota de recoltare a ursului brun. Măsura se aplică de astăzi. Cota crește de la 481 la 969 de exemplare.

latvia.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle, acuzată că a cerut 100.000 $ unui donator MAGA în schimbul sprijinului în relația cu administrația Trump (WSJ)
latvia.description: Kimberly Guilfoyle, ambasadoarea Statelor Unite în Grecia şi fosta logodnică a lui Donald Trump Jr., i-ar fi cerut unui important donator republican să îi achite o datorie de 100.000 de dolari către American Express, în timp ce încerca să obţină confirmarea Senatului pentru postul diplomatic. Potrivit unei investigaţii publicate de The Wall Street Journal, Guilfoyle ar fi promis în schimb să îşi folosească relaţiile din administraţia Trump pentru a-l ajuta pe donator să îşi rezolve problemele fiscale şi juridice.

latvia.title: Proiect pentru dezincriminarea posesiei de droguri. Daniel Fenechiu, unul dintre inițiatori: „Să încercăm o variantă de relaxare”
latvia.description: Proiectul de lege care propune dezincriminarea posesiei de droguri în vederea consumului propriu a fost lansat pentru a prezenta o soluție cu privire la modul în care statul român ar putea combate acest fenomen, a declarat Daniel Fenechiu, unul dintre inițiatori, într-un interviu acordat Digi24.ro. „Din păcate, în momentul ăsta, în România lupta împotriva traficului de droguri este o luptă împotriva consumatorului”, este constatarea senatorului liberal.

latvia.title: Cum am supraviețui fără curent zile întregi? Un student din Oradea a făcut un scurtmetraj premiat de NATO
latvia.description: Cum ne-am descurca dacă am rămâne zile întregi fără electricitate? Un student din Oradea a transformat acest scenariu într-un scurtmetraj despre supraviețuirea în timpul unui blackout prelungit. Producția sa a fost înscrisă într-o competiție NATO, unde a obținut locul al treilea și premiul de popularitate.

latvia.title: Escrocherii realizate cu ajutorul AI de către un demnitar din Mexic
latvia.description: Autorităţile mexicane au anunţat arestarea unui fost oficial guvernamental regional, acuzat că a escrocat judecători, guvernatori şi membri ai preşedinţiei, prin clonarea vocilor lor folosind inteligenţa artificială, transmite vineri AFP, preluată de Agerpres. Ministerul Securităţii a anunţat arestarea unui fost trezorier al statului Michoacán, precum şi a soţiei, copiilor şi uneia dintre gărzile sale de …

latvia.title: Parchetul General nu vrea dezincriminarea deţinerii de droguri pentru consum propriu. Ce motive invocă
latvia.description: Parchetul General nu este de acord cu iniţiativa legislativă care vizează dezincriminarea deţinerii de droguri pentru consum propriu, listând o întreagă listă de motive. Procurorul general Cristina Chiriac a transmis vineri un punct de vedere al Ministerului Public în legătură proiectul de lege iniţiat de senatorii Victoria Stoiciu (neafiliată), Cristian Ghinea (USR) şi Daniel Fenechiu …

latvia.title: NATO chief Mark Rutte to visit Estonia next week
latvia.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is due to visit Estonia next week, meeting the country's leaders and visiting Ämari Air Base and Tallinn University of Technology.

latvia.title: NÄDALA NÄGU ⟩ Margus Tsahkna hilinenud kaitsekõne
latvia.description: On lihtne teha populaarseid otsuseid, mida kõik toetavad ja kiidavad: kehtestame Venemaale sanktsioonid, toetame Ukrainat, kutsume ellu rahvusvahelise tribunali. Aga julge-olekuteemadel ja sõjas on paratamatu, et vahel on valik halva ja halvema vahel.

latvia.title: Ukraina kirjanikud ei anna alla ega lase ennast enam nii lihtsalt vahistada nagu Stalini ajal
latvia.description: See, mida venelased meiega teevad, on nagu igavene tsükkel: nad hävitavad parimaid, et nende asemele oma eliiti kasvatada ja seejärel ülejäänud assimileerida, räägib Ukraina kirjandusuurija ja ajakirjanik Tetjana Oharkova.

latvia.title: Venemaa nõuab Ukraina energiataristu rünnakute peatamise läbirääkimise eest USA sanktsioonide leevendamist
latvia.description: Venemaa nõuab USA-lt sanktsioonide leevendamist osana läbirääkimistest võimaliku Ukraina energiataristu vastase rünnakute lõpetamise üle. Kiiev kardab, et Kreml kasutab läbirääkimisi täiendavate järeleandmiste saamiseks, ilma et tal oleks tegelikku kavatsust sõjategevust piirata.

latvia.title: Latvians made more than 5 million trips last year
latvia.description: In 2025, there were 1.20 billion personal and professional trips made by residents in the EU, a 1.4% increase from 2024 (+17 million trips). Of the total, 848 million were domestic trips (70% of the total) and 264 million were foreign trips within the EU (22%), which means 92% of the trips made by EU residents were intra-EU. This information comes from data on trips by EU residents published by Eurostat today.

latvia.title: 'Severe' weather alert issued along Latvia's western coast
latvia.description: All of Latvia's western coastline in Kurzeme region has a severe weather warning in place for Friday afternoon and evening.

latvia.title: New species of lichen found in Latvia
latvia.description: A species of lichen, Pseudothelomma ocellatum, has been recorded in Latvia for the first time, according to the Latvian Mycological Society. The lichen was found on the grounds of the ‘Kalna Kaibēni’ museum.

latvia.title: airBaltic to suspend some routes this winter season
latvia.description: Several airBaltic passengers have been informed that their pre-paid flights have been rescheduled or cancelled. The national airline explained that one of the main factors is the rise in aviation fuel prices. Flights on several routes will resume during the summer season, but flights on the Riga–Innsbruck route will be suspended entirely, Latvian Radio reports on October 9.

latvia.title: Latvian actress Indra Briķe passes away
latvia.description: On 9 October, Indra Briķe (29 December 1957 – 9 October 2026), a long-time actress at the Dailes Theatre, passed away, as reported by ‘Kroders.lv’ and confirmed by the theatre.

latvia.title: Booze bribe case heads to court in Valmiera, Latvia
latvia.description: A case has been referred to the Vidzeme District Court in which the director of a company and another individual are accused of offering a bribe – a bottle of cognac and 1,000 euros – to an official of the Valmiera Municipal Council, and of aiding and abetting the bribery, the prosecutor's office said in a release.

latvia.title: Another toddler wanders off from same Bauska kindergarten
latvia.description: On Thursday, a three-year-old child once again wandered off unsupervised from the “Pasaulīte” kindergarten in Bauska; this is the second such incident this year, the Bauska Municipal Council told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Sound Forest, Open House, Symphony
latvia.description: If storm and rain don't scare you, here are a few things to do this weekend.

latvia.title: Smiltēns could be next Latvian Saeima Speaker
latvia.description: The Speaker of the 15th Saeima could be the current Minister for Justice, Edvards Smiltēns, of the United List, who already has experience in the role of Speaker of Parliament, according to sources at Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Pro-Kremlin activist case goes back to court in Latvia
latvia.description: The Supreme Court has annulled the Rīga Regional Court’s ruling in a case in which the defendant was sentenced to three years’ imprisonment for publicly glorifying crimes against peace and war crimes by displaying various symbols associated with Russia and the Soviet Union in the windows of her home, Latvian Television reported on October 8.

latvia.title: Strongest winds will be on Latvian western coast Friday
latvia.description: A strong wind warning will be in force in Latvia on Friday afternoon, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 7th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Two 'Latvian nationals' arrested for entering airbase in England
latvia.description: Two men described as being Latvian were arrested on October 8th on suspicion of illegally entering a Royal Air Force (RAF) military base in Cambridgeshire, England which is used by the United States Air Force.

latvia.title: 'Two-basket' healthcare system postponed again in Latvia
latvia.description: The Saeima has postponed the introduction of the so-called ‘two healthcare service baskets’ principle for a further year – until 31 December next year – as decided by parliament on Thursday during the second and final reading under an urgent procedure. The introduction of this principle has been postponed for several years now, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Annual inflation in Latvia at 3.2% in September
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data, published on 8 October, show that compared with September 2025, the average level of consumer prices rose by 3.2 % in September 2026.

latvia.title: Wind alerts in force for Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 9 October, strong winds are expected in Latvia, which may cause damage in some areas, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (LVĢMC).

latvia.title: Russians, Belarusians banned from owning critical infrastructure in Latvia
latvia.description: Citizens of Russia and Belarus will not be able to acquire a significant stake or exert decisive influence in critical infrastructure facilities in Latvia, the Saeima decided on Thursday, 8 October, as reported by LSM.lv and LETA.

latvia.title: Latvian book exhibition opens at European Parliament
latvia.description: An exhibition dedicated to 500 years since the first book in Latvian was published was opened at the European Parliament (EP) building in Strasbourg this week. The exhibition was created in cooperation with the National Library of Latvia (LNB), reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Theatre director Hermanis quits as leader of party he founded
latvia.description: The head of the New Riga Theatre, director Alvis Hermanis, has resigned from his duties as the leader of the "We Change the Rules" (MMN) party, he has announced on social media.

latvia.title: Former Latvian football captain set to head civil service
latvia.description: The post-playing careers of many former professional footballers often include punditry and coaching, but Latvia's former national football captain is in line to head the country's civil service.

latvia.title: 'Burnout alley' unveiled in Rīga
latvia.description: This week, special attention is being paid to mental health, as World Mental Health Day will be observed across the globe on Saturday. During Mental Health Week, a series of events is taking place at the National Centre for Mental Health, and an art walk dedicated to burnout was opened on Wednesday, Latvian Television reported on October 7.

latvia.title: Latvia's High Five charity drive to focus on mental health this year
latvia.description: Latvian Public Media (LSM)’s charity marathon “Dod pieci!/High Five!” will focus this year on mental health and suicide prevention in Latvian society, the organisers have announced.

latvia.title: Quarter of postal votes deemed invalid in Latvia
latvia.description: In the recent 15th Saeima elections, out of the 444 postal votes received by the Latvian Postal Voting Commission, 118 were deemed invalid, the Central Election Commission (CVK) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Flu monitoring season begins in Latvia
latvia.description: The 2026–2027 monitoring season for influenza and other acute respiratory infections has begun in Latvia, but so far, Latvia has only received the intranasal ‘Fluenz’ vaccine, which is intended for children who belong to specific health risk groups, according to the Disease Prevention and Control Centre (SPKC). This season, the production of influenza vaccines in Europe has been delayed; consequently, vaccine deliveries to Latvia are taking place gradually and slightly later than usual this year. Deliveries of the ‘Efluelda’ flu vaccine to GP practices will begin this week. This vaccine is intended for people aged 60 and over, as well as those with moderate or severe immunosuppression. Meanwhile, the “Vaxigrip” vaccine, which is intended for other target groups eligible for state-funded vaccination – including adults and children with chronic illnesses – is expected to arrive in Latvia by 13 November. This season, state-funded flu vaccination will be provided using three vaccines, each intended for different population groups. The first laboratory-confirmed cases of flu in Latvia this season were recorded even before the start of the flu monitoring season and were linked to travel outside Latvia. Meanwhile, in week 40 of 2026, when monitoring began, influenza was clinically diagnosed in three patients, or 3.9 cases per 100,000 population, which is lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season (9.9 cases per 100,000 population). A total of 918 patients, or an average of 1,179.3 per 100,000 population, consulted their GPs with symptoms of other acute respiratory infections. The prevalence of other acute respiratory infections is also slightly lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season. Last week, influenza was not laboratory-confirmed in any of the 166 samples tested, whilst RSV infection was confirmed in one sample (0.6 per cent), according to laboratory surveillance data. The proportion of Covid-19-positive samples was 1.2 per cent, remaining at roughly the same level as the previous week. Unlike in previous years, no increase in Covid-19 cases was observed in late summer and early autumn this year.

lithuania.description: Ascensiunea partidelor de extremă dreaptă în Europa stârnește îngrijorări în NATO, pe fondul riscului ca acestea să reducă sprijinul public pentru creșterea bugetelor de apărare și pentru ajutorul militar acordat Ucrainei. În Franța, Italia, Germania, Polonia, România și alte state europene, formațiunile de dreapta radicală folosesc nemulțumirile legate de costul vieții pentru a contesta cheltuielile militare și proiectele comune de apărare ale Uniunii Europene, potrivit Politico.

lithuania.title: Alertă de securitate la o bază militară britanică folosită de SUA și NATO. Doi cetățeni letoni au fost arestați
lithuania.description: Doi cetățeni letoni au fost arestați după ce au fost descoperiți în incinta unei baze militare britanice care găzduiește centre de informații ale SUA și NATO. Cei doi ar fi pătruns în baza RAF Molesworth printr-o breșă în gardul împrejmuitor, iar incidentul este investigat de poliția antiteroristă, relatează BBC.

lithuania.title: Fregata „Regele Ferdinand” revine la Constanța după cinci săptămâni de misiune NATO în Mediterana
lithuania.description: Fregata „Regele Ferdinand” revine în ţară, la începutul săptămânii viitoare, după ce a participat, timp de cinci săptămâni, la o misiune NATO în Marea Mediterană, au anunţat, joi, reprezentanţii Forţelor Navale Române. Ei au precizat că nava a executat activităţi de supraveghere şi de monitorizare a traficului maritim în zona respectivă.

lithuania.title: Senatorul PNL Varga Glad explică de ce crește cota la ursul brun: „Viețile unor oameni și familii au fost schimbate pentru totdeauna”
lithuania.description: Președintele Comisiei pentru mediu din Senatul Româmâniei, Senatorul PNL Varga Glad, a explicat pe pagina sa de Facebook de ce a crescut cota de recoltare a ursului brun. Măsura se aplică de astăzi. Cota crește de la 481 la 969 de exemplare.

lithuania.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle, acuzată că a cerut 100.000 $ unui donator MAGA în schimbul sprijinului în relația cu administrația Trump (WSJ)
lithuania.description: Kimberly Guilfoyle, ambasadoarea Statelor Unite în Grecia şi fosta logodnică a lui Donald Trump Jr., i-ar fi cerut unui important donator republican să îi achite o datorie de 100.000 de dolari către American Express, în timp ce încerca să obţină confirmarea Senatului pentru postul diplomatic. Potrivit unei investigaţii publicate de The Wall Street Journal, Guilfoyle ar fi promis în schimb să îşi folosească relaţiile din administraţia Trump pentru a-l ajuta pe donator să îşi rezolve problemele fiscale şi juridice.

lithuania.title: Proiect pentru dezincriminarea posesiei de droguri. Daniel Fenechiu, unul dintre inițiatori: „Să încercăm o variantă de relaxare”
lithuania.description: Proiectul de lege care propune dezincriminarea posesiei de droguri în vederea consumului propriu a fost lansat pentru a prezenta o soluție cu privire la modul în care statul român ar putea combate acest fenomen, a declarat Daniel Fenechiu, unul dintre inițiatori, într-un interviu acordat Digi24.ro. „Din păcate, în momentul ăsta, în România lupta împotriva traficului de droguri este o luptă împotriva consumatorului”, este constatarea senatorului liberal.

lithuania.title: Cum am supraviețui fără curent zile întregi? Un student din Oradea a făcut un scurtmetraj premiat de NATO
lithuania.description: Cum ne-am descurca dacă am rămâne zile întregi fără electricitate? Un student din Oradea a transformat acest scenariu într-un scurtmetraj despre supraviețuirea în timpul unui blackout prelungit. Producția sa a fost înscrisă într-o competiție NATO, unde a obținut locul al treilea și premiul de popularitate.

lithuania.title: Escrocherii realizate cu ajutorul AI de către un demnitar din Mexic
lithuania.description: Autorităţile mexicane au anunţat arestarea unui fost oficial guvernamental regional, acuzat că a escrocat judecători, guvernatori şi membri ai preşedinţiei, prin clonarea vocilor lor folosind inteligenţa artificială, transmite vineri AFP, preluată de Agerpres. Ministerul Securităţii a anunţat arestarea unui fost trezorier al statului Michoacán, precum şi a soţiei, copiilor şi uneia dintre gărzile sale de …

lithuania.title: Parchetul General nu vrea dezincriminarea deţinerii de droguri pentru consum propriu. Ce motive invocă
lithuania.description: Parchetul General nu este de acord cu iniţiativa legislativă care vizează dezincriminarea deţinerii de droguri pentru consum propriu, listând o întreagă listă de motive. Procurorul general Cristina Chiriac a transmis vineri un punct de vedere al Ministerului Public în legătură proiectul de lege iniţiat de senatorii Victoria Stoiciu (neafiliată), Cristian Ghinea (USR) şi Daniel Fenechiu …

lithuania.title: NATO chief Mark Rutte to visit Estonia next week
lithuania.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is due to visit Estonia next week, meeting the country's leaders and visiting Ämari Air Base and Tallinn University of Technology.

lithuania.title: NÄDALA NÄGU ⟩ Margus Tsahkna hilinenud kaitsekõne
lithuania.description: On lihtne teha populaarseid otsuseid, mida kõik toetavad ja kiidavad: kehtestame Venemaale sanktsioonid, toetame Ukrainat, kutsume ellu rahvusvahelise tribunali. Aga julge-olekuteemadel ja sõjas on paratamatu, et vahel on valik halva ja halvema vahel.

lithuania.title: Ukraina kirjanikud ei anna alla ega lase ennast enam nii lihtsalt vahistada nagu Stalini ajal
lithuania.description: See, mida venelased meiega teevad, on nagu igavene tsükkel: nad hävitavad parimaid, et nende asemele oma eliiti kasvatada ja seejärel ülejäänud assimileerida, räägib Ukraina kirjandusuurija ja ajakirjanik Tetjana Oharkova.

lithuania.title: Venemaa nõuab Ukraina energiataristu rünnakute peatamise läbirääkimise eest USA sanktsioonide leevendamist
lithuania.description: Venemaa nõuab USA-lt sanktsioonide leevendamist osana läbirääkimistest võimaliku Ukraina energiataristu vastase rünnakute lõpetamise üle. Kiiev kardab, et Kreml kasutab läbirääkimisi täiendavate järeleandmiste saamiseks, ilma et tal oleks tegelikku kavatsust sõjategevust piirata.

lithuania.title: Tallinn Film Festival to showcase lots of Latvian talent
lithuania.description: The 30th Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF) will place Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania at the heart of its 2026 edition with a special 'Focus on Baltics'. Taking place from 6–22 November 2026, the anniversary edition will bring the latest and the best of Baltic films to international audiences while creating new opportunities for the region’s filmmakers and industry professionals.

lithuania.title: “Nacisti meklē nacistus!” Slaidiņš ēterā bez aplinkiem izskaidro Kremļa jaunākos murgus par Baltiju
lithuania.description: Krievija turpina izmantot Otrā pasaules kara tematiku un apsūdzības “nacismā”, lai pamatotu savu retoriku par Baltijas valstīm un Ukrainu. Krievijas Ģenerālprokuratūra atkal pievērsusies jautājumam par iespējamiem “nacistiem” Baltijā, savukārt Kremlis turpina atkārtot vēstījumus par Krievijas tiesībām atbildēt uz Ukrainas rīcību. TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš norādīja, ka […]

lithuania.title: Ukrainas droni paralizē gaisa satiksmi Maskavā – arī Putina lidmašīna starp tām, kas nevarēja nosēsties
lithuania.description: Maskavā iestājies pamatīgs haoss – slēgtas vairākas galvaspilsētas lidostas, un tieši šī iemesla dēļ tajās nevarēja nolaisties arī Krievijas diktatora Vladimira Putina lidmašīna, sociālajos tīklos paziņojis bijušais Ukrainas iekšlietu ministra padomnieks Antons Geraščenko. Putins atgriezies no vizītes Turkmenistānā, taču viņa lidaparāts bijis spiests riņķot gaidīšanas zonā netālu no Maskavas. Pēc Krievijas “Telegram” kanālos ziņotā, kaut […]

lithuania.title: Armands Puče aicina mainīt attieksmi pret pasaules kārtību: “Prioritāte ir šeit, mums pašiem”
lithuania.description: Latvijai jāmaina attieksme pret pasaules kārtību un daudz lielāka uzmanība jāpievērš pašas spējai aizsargāt savu valsti. Lai gan dalība NATO un citās starptautiskajās organizācijās ir nozīmīga, izšķirošā brīdī Latvijai vispirms jāspēj paļauties uz saviem spēkiem, tā TV24 raidījumā “Preses klubs” norādīja žurnālists, TV24 ētera personība Armands Puče, komentējot drošības situāciju un Krievijas radītos draudus Eiropai. […]

lithuania.title: Dėl trikdžių Maskvos oro uostuose iškilo problema ir Putiną skraidinusiam lėktuvui
lithuania.description: Rusijos diktatoriaus Vladimiro Putino lėktuvas, Kremliaus vadovui grįžtant iš Turkmėnistano, negalėjo iš karto nusileisti Maskvoje ir buvo nukreiptas į Sankt Peterburgą, praneša leidinys „Agentstvo“.

lithuania.title: Orai rims, bet žymesnių pokyčių teks palaukti: perspėjama apie šalnas
lithuania.description: Vėjuoti orai po neramaus penktadienio pradės rimti, bet greitų orų pokyčių laukti dar anksti – šeštadienio diena bus debesuota, daug kur palis, kiek gausiau vakariniuose rajonuose.

lithuania.title: Panamą supurtė stiprus žemės drebėjimas, kilo panika: paskelbtas įspėjimas apie cunamio pavojų
lithuania.description: Panamą penktadienį supurtė stiprus žemės drebėjimas, sostinėje sukėlęs paniką.

lithuania.title: Atskleidė „FlyDubai“ užpuoliko piloto tikrąjį tikslą: įkvėpimo sėmėsi iš Rugsėjo 11-osios
lithuania.description: „FlyDubai“ lėktuvo antrasis pilotas, praėjusią savaitę užpuolęs orlaivio kapitoną, planavo sudaužyti lėktuvą Tel Avivo tarptautiniame oro uoste, penktadienį pareiškė Jungtinių Arabų Emyratų (JAE) vyriausiasis prokuroras.

lithuania.title: Mero posto po teismo sprendimo netekęs Malinauskas vėl sieks vadovauti Druskininkams
lithuania.description: Korupcijos byloje nuteistas ir Druskininkų mero įgaliojimų rugsėjo mėnesį netekęs Ričardas Malinauskas penktadienį savo „Facebook“ paskyroje pranešė, kad politinis komitetas „Už Druskininkus“ patvirtino jį kandidatu į Druskininkų merus 2027 metų kovą vyksiančiuose savivaldos rinkimuose.

lithuania.title: JT generalinis sekretorius: JAV sankcijos TBT yra rimtas smūgis tarptautiniam teisingumui
lithuania.description: Jungtinių Tautų (JT) generalinis sekretorius Antonio Guterresas penktadienį pasmerkė Jungtinių Valstijų sprendimą įvesti sankcijas Tarptautiniam Baudžiamajam Teismui (TBT) ir pridūrė, kad yra „giliai susirūpinęs dėl numatomo šių priemonių poveikio“.

lithuania.title: „Rusija parodė, kad turi strategiją“: analitikas pirštu bedė į Vokietiją
lithuania.description: Greita Rusijos reakcija į Vokietijos žvalgybos įspėjimą dėl kylančios grėsmės iš Kremliaus rodo, kad Vladimiro Putino režimas turi strategiją, kaip veikti Vokietijoje. Taip mano saugumo analitikas Raineris Saksas, kuris apie tai prakalbo savo komentare leidiniui „Postimees“.

lithuania.title: Užupyje nebeliko „monstru“ vadinto daugiabučio: kas išdygs jo vietoje?
lithuania.description: Dar prieš dešimtmetį kilęs skandalas dėl daugiabučio išskirtinėje Vilniaus vietoje pagaliau turi pabaigą. Užupio bendruomenė sukilo dėl ne pagal projektą pastatyto daugiabučio ir pasiekė pergalę – statinys pripažintas neteisėtu. Vėliau jo statytojai bankrutavo, o štai namas stovėjo iki dabar. Tik šią savaitę 15min užfiksavo, kad daugiabutis nugriautas. Ir jau yra planas, kas čia iškils ateityje.

lithuania.title: Mirtina nelaimė: Kalvarijoje sunkvežimis pervažiavo ant kelio gulėjusį vyrą
lithuania.description: Kalvarijoje sunkvežimis pervažiavo ant kelio gulėjusį vyrą, praneša Policijos departamentas.

lithuania.title: Tailando karalienė Suthida pirmą kartą viena skrido naikintuvu
lithuania.description: Tailando karalienė Suthida (Sutida) penktadienį pirmą kartą viena skrido naikintuvu „Gripen“, stebint jos vyrui, aistringam pilotui karaliui Mahai Vajiralongkornui.

lithuania.title: Ekspedicija burlaiviu „Brabander“ (5): laivas iš vidaus – tarp burių, sonarų ir kajučių
lithuania.description: Burlaivis „Brabander“ – tai Klaipėdos universiteto mokymo ir mokslinių ekspedicijų platforma, kurioje studentai mokosi tikros jūrinės praktikos, o mokslininkai tiria Baltijos jūrą. Beveik prieš pusę amžiaus Nyderlanduose jaunimui mokyti pastatytas laivas šiandien tęsia iš esmės tą pačią misiją – tik gerokai platesniu mastu. 15min aiškinosi, kas slepiasi po šio išskirtinio laivo deniu – kaip burlaivis veikia, kas slepiasi jo triumuose ir kokį greitį jis gali išvystyti.

lithuania.title: ES smerkia JAV sankcijas TBT, žada padėti teismui vykdyti savo veiklą
lithuania.description: Europos Sąjunga (ES) JAV sankcijas Tarptautiniam Baudžiamajam Teismui (TBT) penktadienį pavadino „labai apmaudžiomis“ ir pareiškė esanti „pasirengusi imtis bet kokių būtinų priemonių, kad teismas galėtų vykdyti savo veiklą“.

lithuania.title: JK karinės bazės teritorijoje sulaikyti du latviai paleisti už užstatą
lithuania.description: Pietryčių Anglijoje esančios karinės bazės teritorijoje Jungtinės Karalystės (JK) policijos sulaikyti du latviai penktadienį buvo paleisti už užstatą.

lithuania.title: Irano gvardija teigia smogusi tanklaiviui, plaukusiam per Hormuzo sąsiaurį „neteisėtu maršrutu“
lithuania.description: Irano revoliucinė gvardija penktadienį pranešė smogusi tanklaiviui, bandžiusiam plaukti „neteisėtu maršrutu“ per Hormuzo sąsiaurį, kurį Teheranas siekia blokuoti nuo tada, kai Artimuosiuose Rytuose prasidėjo karas.

lithuania.title: Savanorių prospekte gatvėje nušautas žmogus: įtariamasis sulaikytas, aiškėja daugiau įvykio aplinkybių
lithuania.description: Penktadienio vakarą policija gavo pranešimą, kad Vilniuje, Savanorių prospekte, viešoje vietoje buvo mirtinai sužalotas žmogus. Atskubėjusios gausios policijos pajėgos nurodytoje vietoje, netoli viešojo transporto stotelės, rado keliais šūviais nužudytą vyrą.

lithuania.title: Valstybės paskirta gynyba teisiamam nepilnamečiui – reali pagalba ar tik formalumas?
lithuania.description: Kovos su prekyba žmonėmis ir išnaudojimu centras iškėlė klausimą, kaip realiai veikia valstybės garantuojama teisinė pagalba suimtiems nepilnamečiams. Diskusiją paskatino pagalbos į centrą besikreipusios motinos istorija – jos nepilnametis sūnus šiuo metu laikomas suimtas, kaltinamas daugybinėmis vagystėmis ir laukia teismo.

lithuania.title: ES: teisių varžymas Turkijoje stabdo jos siekį tapti bloko nare
lithuania.description: Europos Sąjunga (ES) penktadienį išreiškė rimtą susirūpinimą dėl demokratinių standartų Turkijoje ir įspėjo, kad teisių varžymas dar labiau menkina seniai narystės siekiančios Ankaros galimybes prisijungti prie bloko.
